title: 5.1 Fruits
unit_outcome: Express simple food preferences and needs and complete a supported purchase or café order.
goal: Recognize and name six common fruits and connect them to familiar colors and numbers.
grammar_function: Use a/an with one fruit and familiar number + plural noun chunks.
prerequisite: 2.6 Numbers 1-10, 2.7 Basic Colors, 2.8 Count and Describe; singular/plural be from Unit 1.
speaking_outcome: Say the six fruit names or noun phrases clearly enough to be understood.
